title: extract@v1
description: Structured extraction from a single source document (SPEC §5). One per source; assembled into collection<extract@v1> by the map node.

source.description: Human-readable identifier of the source this extraction came from.

requirements.description: Discrete requirements found in the source (each an object). Empty is valid.

decisions.description: Decisions the source records as already made.

constraints.description: Technical, budget, timeline or regulatory constraints.

open_questions.description: Gaps and ambiguities to resolve later; prefer flagging over guessing.

trust_level.description: Confidence in this extraction given the source's clarity.
